messages:
Alex: OpsBot just paged at 03:22 UTC for chat-completions p99 spike, forwarding thread. Not seeing customer-error-rate but latency p99 hit ~2.4s for rw-3.5-chat on us-west-2 for ~6m.
Mira: I’m on it, pulling traces. Can someone confirm whether this is model-specific or route-specific?
Sam: Quick glance at Grafana — the spike lines up with a surge on /v1/chat/completions user_route=autocomplete. Model breakdown shows rw-3.5-chat only, rw-3.0 embeddings unaffected.
Jun: Adding context: we had a canary deploy 22:58 PT (02:58 UTC) earlier to routing rules. Could be routing to smaller instances causing queuing.
OpsBot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0347 - p99 latency spike on chat-completions (us-west-2). Pager sent to @eng-oncall.
Kelsey: I can take a look at capacity. Are we seeing queue_depth increase on the GPU pools?
Mira: queue_depth for pool-chat-usw2 up from avg 3 to 18 during the window. CPU on proxy nodes also briefly saturated.
Alex: Customer impact assessment: no 5xxs, but interactive customers will see sluggish responses. Recommend live mitigation: temporary route fallback to rw-3.5-chat-quantized variant and broaden batching window.
Sam: For short-term, we can flip routing: set policy for autocomplete route to prefer quantized variant with same semantic profile. Patch I’d run:
```
PATCH routing policy /services/chat/routes/autocomplete
- priority: "balanced"
+ priority: "latency_plan_b"
+ fallback_models: ["rw-3.5-chat-quant", "rw-3.4-lite"]
+ max_batch_delay_ms: 40
```
Jun: That will help latency but might change token-cost slightly. Need approval from Kelsey for capacity cost.
Kelsey: Approve for 30m mitigation. Sam, Mira execute and report metrics in 10m.
Mira: Executing now -> `rcli route set ...`
OpsBot: DEPLOY: routing-change @sam by mira at 03:29 UTC.
Sam: Done. Early telemetry: p99 dropped from 2400ms -> 1200ms in first 60s. queue_depth back to normal.
Alex: Good. Postmortem action: adjust p99 alerting to reduce noise and make it more route-aware. Current config triggers on cluster-wide p99 > 1500ms for 5m; that fires on noisy single-route microbursts.
Mira: Proposal: split alerts by route + model_family and change condition to relative-rate instead of absolute ms for p99. Eg: alert when p99 > (baseline + 50%) AND > 1500ms for 3m, or when >0.5% of requests exceed 2s over 5m.
Sam: Concrete Datadog/slo query I tested: `avg(last_5m):percentile(99.0,trace.duration){env:prod,route:autocomplete,model_family:rw-3.5} > (baseline*1.5) && (percent_over_2s > 0.5)`
Kelsey: Also want to avoid paging for short blips. Suggest adding: require sustained condition for 3 consecutive 1m buckets or use anomaly detection.
Jun: Agreed. For routing we should also add a lightweight dashboard with per-route p50/p95/p99, queue_depth, and model fallback count. Grafana panel suggestions:
- time series: p99 by route (stacked)
- heatmap: per-model tail latency
- stat: current queued requests
- table: recent rollbacks/fallback triggers
Alex: Can someone draft a PR to change the alert rules and add a dashboard? Tag it with INC-2026-0347. Owner: Sam for alerts, Mira for dashboard.
Sam: Will draft alert PR. Proposed alert YAML snippet:
```
- name: chat-completions-p99-per-route
  expr: |
    (percentile_over_time(99, trace.duration{env=\"prod\",route=~\"/v1/chat.*\"}[5m]) > ((route_baseline * 1.5) and > 1500))
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alerts/chat-p99-route
```
Mira: Dashboard PR coming up. Will include a compact view for oncall to triage without digging into logs.
Kelsey: After PRs, we should run a 2-week silence window on the old global p99 alert and monitor false positives. If new route-level alerts behave, retire the global.
Jun: Also add a suppression for known planned deploy windows and autoscale warmups.
Alex: Recording action items: 1) Sam: open alert PR + link to INC-2026-0347, 2) Mira: dashboard PR, 3) Kelsey: confirm quota/cost implications for fallback, 4) Jun: add suppression list for deploy windows, 5) Alex: write short post-incident note.
Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/1423 - initial rule + tests.
Mira: Dashboard PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/grafana/dashboards/pulls/771 - includes per-route panels and quick-links to traces.
Kelsey: Monitoring the canary of new alerts for 48h then decide on retiring global p99.
Alex: Thanks all. Closing the paging channel unless something else shows up. Marking INC-2026-0347 as mitigated.
